scripts.setup: rm -rf dev.db dev.db-journal migrations .hekireki && cp schemas/before.prisma schema.prisma && mkdir -p migrations/20260101000000_init && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema schema.prisma --script -o migrations/20260101000000_init/migration.sql && printf 'provider = "sqlite"\n' > migrations/migration_lock.toml && prisma migrate deploy && prisma db execute --file data.sql
scripts.demo: pnpm run setup && pnpm run rows && pnpm run schema:after && (pnpm run check || true) && mkdir -p .hekireki && cp decisions.json .hekireki/migrate.json && pnpm run check && mkdir -p migrations/20260201000000_users_and_posts && prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema schema.prisma --script -o migrations/20260201000000_users_and_posts/migration.sql && hekireki migrate plan --schema schema.prisma --migration migrations/20260201000000_users_and_posts/migration.sql --output migrations/20260201000000_users_and_posts/migration.sql && cat migrations/20260201000000_users_and_posts/migration.sql && prisma migrate deploy && pnpm run rows
